text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: …So, what do you think of the Ship of Theseus?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Come on, Trainer, you know… the paradox.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: If, at the end of my research, there was a discovery that reconstructs everything…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: The structure formed after undergoing all its changes… how much of it could still be considered an Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That has been the question… spinning around in my head recently.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon stares off into space.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Is our nonstop racing beginning to take a toll? I should probably rethink her race schedule.
